$comment: Single source of the design tokens. Edit values here, then run `node tools/design_doc.js --write` (docs + generated code regions) and, for colours used in images, `node tools/make_assets.js`. `npm test` fails while anything generated from this file is stale. In CSS a token is written as @<group>.<name>@ (example: @c.bg@, @sp.4@); tools/build.js replaces it with the value at build time, because the TV's browser (WebKit 537) has no CSS variables.
scaling: All sizes are px on the fixed 1280 x 720 stage (the TV upscales it to the panel). For a port to a bigger stage multiply every px token by the stage factor and round to whole px: 1920 x 1080 = x1.5, 3840 x 2160 = x3. Colours, font weights, letter-spacing ratios, durations, easing curves, z-layers and the focus scale stay as they are. 1 px hairlines become 2 px at x1.5 or more so they stay visible. Font sizes scale too (16 px minimum becomes 24 px at 1080p).

c.title: Colours
c.description: Dark theme. Contrast numbers are measured against `bg`. Rules: body text never below 7:1 (so text-1/text-2); text-3 only at 16 px or larger and never over images; semi-transparent colours only on small areas (Orsay repaints large alpha areas slowly).

bg.description: Page background, opaque bottom band, outline of the pointer, dark modules of the QR code

panel.description: Opaque side panels: expanded navigation, selection/help panel. Every accent colour is checked to reach 4.5:1 on it

surface-1.description: Dialogs, Up Next card, settings description, pointer arrow pills, list cards

surface-2.description: Image placeholders, on-screen keys, chips, cover backgrounds

surface-3.description: Buttons at rest, toasts and the new content notice, focused settings row, current A-Z letter

line.description: Lines, progress tracks, unwatched cell of the season strip, toggle track (off)

line-soft.description: Separator between settings rows (quieter than line)

disabled-bg.description: Background of a locked player button (previous/next at the start/end of a queue), a little quieter than surface-3

key-rim.description: Key cap outline, login step circles, selected season segment

thumb-bg.description: Placeholder behind small thumbnails in panel lists

text-1.description: Primary text, neutral badges, active tab, rail marker, toggle track (on). 17.1:1

text-2.description: Secondary text, meta lines, watched cell of the season strip. 9.9:1

text-3.description: Tertiary / disabled text (16 px or larger, never over images; only 4.0:1 on surface-3). 5.6:1

text-soft.description: Screensaver sub line and poster clock: between text-1 and text-2, calmer over photos

text-amb.description: Second caption line over the ambient library background (a bit brighter than text-3 for readability)

on-accent.description: Text and icons on the accent colour and on text-1 areas (every palette colour reaches 4.5:1 with it)

danger.description: Errors, wrong PIN, red colour key (A). 5.2:1

success.description: Confirmation, green colour key (B), dev FPS text. 7.0:1

marker.description: Intro/credits segments in the player scrubber

tick.description: Minor tick marks of the fine-scrubbing bar (quieter than the text-2 major ticks)

wedge.description: The two wedge lines that connect the magnified range on the progress bar with the fine-scrubbing bar

offline-bg.description: Background of the offline bar (no connection)

online-bg.description: Background of the bar when the connection is back

video-bg.description: Placeholder behind the video plane before the first frame

white.description: Pure white: QR code panel (scanner contrast) and subtitle text

black.description: Pure black: screensaver stage, solid subtitle box, dev FPS overlay

avatar-0.description: Avatar / title-card fallback colour 0 of 8 (chosen by a hash of the name)

track-on-image.description: Progress track drawn on top of card artwork

dim.description: Dimming behind side panels and the expanded navigation (0.45 was too weak on bright images)

bg-60.description: bg at 60 %: home clock pill, A-Z column over the ambient background

osd.description: Player OSD islands and the buffering box over video

saver-dim.description: Darkening of screensaver photos (with the scrim images white text stays readable)

sub-bg.description: Default subtitle box behind the text

rule-on-image.description: Thin rule of the "lower third" screensaver style (text-1 at 55 %)

accent.title: Accent palette
accent.description: The accent colour means focus or progress only. The user picks one of these colours (Settings > Display > Accent colour). In CSS always write @accent@ (not a palette token): tools/build.js fills in the brand default and generates one `.ac-<id>` variant per other colour. Each brand profile (brand/<id>.json) picks its default with `accentId` and may override that colour's value with its own `accent` (that override lives only in the brand profile). Every colour must reach 4.5:1 with on-accent text on it and 4.5:1 on `panel` (tests/accent.test.js). Generated into src/core/accent.js (PALETTE).

ty.title: Typography
ty.description: Design font Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1, rsms.me/inter), weights 400 and 600. The 2014 build ships no font file and falls back to the TV's sans-serif (SPEC B-15); a port should bundle Inter or use a platform font with similar metrics. Hard minimum 16 px for every text (build gate). Each style: size / line-height / weight (/ letter-spacing). Rules whose size and line-height match a style use that style's tokens.

family.description: Font stack (Inter first where installed or bundled); the TV system font runs wider, so text boxes keep 10 % reserve

display.size.description: display: hero title, detail title without logo

h1.size.description: h1: page titles, episode title in details

small.size.description: small: metadata, hints, second card line, tech chips

label.size.description: label: badges, key caps, overlines (upper case), chips

sp.title: Spacing
sp.description: 4 px grid (base unit 8). Used for padding and margins; the number is the multiple of 4 px. Positions (left/top) are layout geometry and stay literal.

16.description: 64 px (step of the scale, currently not used in the CSS)

r.title: Corner radii
r.description: Radii of rectangles. Circles and pills (radius = half the height) are geometry and stay literal.

xs.description: Key caps, colour keys, count badge, small thumbnails

sm.description: Cards, chips, track list rows, artwork

md.description: Buttons, rail/menu items, settings rows, keys, panels entries

lg.description: Toast, offline bar, large player button

xl.description: OSD islands, buffering box, classic screensaver box

2xl.description: Dialogs, QR panel, Up Next card

fo.title: Focus
fo.description: Focus is shown by the accent colour plus a scale on a permanent GPU layer. No z-index change on focus.

ring-width.description: Border width of the moving focus ring

ring-radius.description: Radius of the focus ring (card radius 6 + gap 8)

row-border.description: Border of a settings row (always present, transparent at rest, accent when focused, so focus never changes layout)

scale.description: Scale of focused cards, avatars, icon buttons

mo.title: Motion
mo.description: Only -webkit-transform and opacity on small elements; 150 ms or less; ease-out. Reduced motion (.rm) switches transitions off.

base.description: Cards, focus ring, rows/pages scrolling, navigation panel, toast

slow.description: Soft fades: ambient background cross-fade (opacity of a full-screen layer, the one exception) and the new content notice

spin.description: One turn of the spinner (linear, endless)

z.title: Layers (z-index)
z.description: Global stacking order of the app layers (higher is in front). Local stacking inside a component stays literal.

float.description: Floating controls: pointer arrows, jump bubble, T9 bar, mini player

pointer.description: Own pointer element (Smart Control), always on top

l.title: Layout
l.description: Constants of the 10-foot layout. Title-safe area is 64 / 36 px (left-right / top-bottom), action-safe 45 / 25 px.

rail-w.description: Width of the collapsed navigation rail

nav-w.description: Width of the expanded navigation panel

content-x.description: Left content edge on screens with the rail

safe-x.description: Title-safe margin left/right; content edge of full-screen views (player, screensaver)

panel-x.description: Left edge of the right side panel (screen-w - panel-w)

panel-w.description: Width of the right side panel (selection, audio/subtitles, help)

icons.description: Icon sprite (src/assets/icons.png): one 32 px cell per icon and colour state. Column = icon (order: design/icons/order.json, append only), row = colour state. Sources: design/icons/<name>.svg (28 x 28 view box, drawn into the cell with 2 px inset).
